papers.abstract: Batillitermes monachus, a termitine genus and species from Zimbabwe, is descriptionbed as new. The descriptionption is based on the soldier and worker castes; the imago is unknown. Data on biology and distribution are given, followed by a discussion on the relationships of the genus.
papers.title: Batillitermes monachus (Isoptera: Termitidae: Termitinae), a new termite genus and species from southern Africa
